Class AdviceModeImportSelector<A extends Annotation>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.context.annotation.AdviceModeImportSelector<A>
Type Parameters:
A - 包含AdviceMode 属性的注解
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImportSelector
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncConfigurationSelector, CachingConfigurationSelector, TransactionManagementConfigurationSelector
public abstract class AdviceModeImportSelector<A extends Annotation> extends Object implements ImportSelector
用于基于注解（如 `@Enable*` 注解）中的 `AdviceMode` 值来选择导入的 `ImportSelector` 实现的便捷基类。
Since:
3.1
Author:
Chris Beams

    • getAdviceModeAttributeName

      protected String getAdviceModeAttributeName()
      指定泛型类型 `A` 的注解的 `AdviceMode` 属性名称。默认值为 "mode"<A extends Annotation>，但子类可以重写它以进行自定义。

    • selectImports

      public final String[] selectImports(AnnotationMetadata importingClassMetadata)
      This implementation resolves the type of annotation from generic metadata and validates that (a) the annotation is in fact present on the importing @Configuration class and (b) that the given annotation has an advice mode attribute of type AdviceMode.

      随后调用 `selectImports(AdviceMode)` 方法，允许具体实现以安全且便捷的方式选择导入。

      Specified by:
      `selectImports` 接口 `ImportSelector` 中
      Returns:
      类名，或如果没有则为空数组
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - 如果导入的 @Configuration 类上缺少预期的注解 A，或者 selectImports(AdviceMode) 返回 null

    • selectImports

      protected abstract String @Nullable [] selectImports(AdviceMode adviceMode)
      Determine which classes should be imported based on the given AdviceMode.

      从此方法返回 `null` 表示无法处理或未知该 `AdviceMode`，此时应抛出 `IllegalArgumentException`。

      Parameters:
      adviceMode - 通过泛型指定的注解的advice mode 属性的值。
      Returns:
      包含要导入的类的数组（如果没有则为空数组；如果给定的 `AdviceMode` 未知则为`null`）
